text: GOOOAAAALLL!! BRIGHTON LEAD 2-0! Joao Pedro has been very lively so far today and he has a goal to go with his assist.
GOOOAAALLL!!! BRIGHTON 1-0 TOTTENHAM! Joao Pedro drives into the box, then back out of it, before picking out Hinshelwood.
GOOOAAAALLL!!!! BRIGHTON 4-0 TOTTENHAM!! This is getting embarrassing for Tottenham now.
Perhaps the fact Veliz scored helped him in a way.
GOOOOAAALLL!!! WHAT A STRIKE! This is superb from the returning Estupinan.
Richarlison scored an offside goal for Spurs near enough right from kick-off, but since then there has been no danger for the hosts.
GOOOAAALLL!!! TOTTENHAM HAVE ONE BACK! Kulusevski refuses to give up and blocks a pass from Dunk.
GOAL DISALLOWED! Buonanotte thinks he has given Brighton a third goal, but he is just offside when meeting - and converting - Welbeck's cross.
Porro is disposed and the Brighton counter ends with Welbeck aiming to bend one into the far corner, but he does not get enough whip on it and Vicario keeps it out.
ANOTHER SAVE! Tottenham have well and truly ramped up the pressure.
ANOTHER SAVE! Vicario is keeping Tottenham in this match.
SO CLOSE! Richarlison controls Son's pass inside the box, turns and sends a shot curling wide of the post.
